Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 6), the Planner incorrectly calculated Edward Dearle's lifespan. The Planner read the death year as 1861 instead of the correct 1891 found in the search results, resulting in a calculated lifespan of ~55 years for Edward Dearle instead of ~85 years. This factual error led to the wrong conclusion that Michael Doeberl lived longer, when in reality, Edward Dearle lived longer (85 years vs 67 years).
